title: Taipei at Year-End: Choose Your Experiences
intro: Family and friends aged 11–70 will see the same experience cards. Each card asks only whether you are interested; different experiences at the same place can be chosen separately. Planning currently assumes 2026, and durations are estimates. Shops, prices, exhibitions, weather and accessibility needs should be confirmed before the trip.

dadaocheng-sunset.title: Watch sunset at Dadaocheng Wharf
dadaocheng-sunset.description: Watch sunset colors reflect on the river and stay as the sky darkens. It can be windy, and the weather determines the view.
dadaocheng-sunset.sourceTitle: Dadaocheng Wharf / Container Market | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking; bicycles also use the riverside. Keep warm in windy weather.
facts.seasonalNote: Sunset colors and visibility depend on the weather; a glowing sky is not guaranteed.

dadaocheng-sunset.imageAlt: Dadaocheng Wharf / Container Market — location photo: Sunlight over the river at sunset (source: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism)
dadaocheng-sunset.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

dadaocheng-food.title: Dine at the wharf's container market
dadaocheng-food.description: Choose a meal and sit by the river to chat. Outdoor dining is the attraction; food choices, seats and queues still need checking.
dadaocheng-food.sourceTitle: iTravelBlog / 安雅 | Wharf and Container Market Visit (2021-11-20; updated 2026-04-16)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Outdoor dining and walking; at busy times, you may need to queue or wait for a seat.
facts.seasonalNote: Shops, seating and operating arrangements depend on conditions that day.

dadaocheng-food.imageAlt: Tables and chairs beside the river at the wharf market
dadaocheng-food.imageCredit: Lagoon Commercial Furniture | Dadaocheng Wharf project (2025-08-14)

dihua-architecture.title: Explore red-brick arches and old houses on Dihua Street
dihua-architecture.description: Walk along the street looking at red-brick arches, old doors, windows and walls, stopping for photos. Spend this time on the buildings and browse fewer shops.
dihua-architecture.sourceTitle: Dadaocheng / Dihua Street Shophouses | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking along arcades and streets; watch for intersections, thresholds and crowds.

dihua-architecture.imageAlt: Dadaocheng / Dihua Street Shophouses — location photo: Historic red-brick arcades
dihua-architecture.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

yongle-fabric.title: Browse fabric and threads at Yongle Market
yongle-fabric.description: Compare fabric patterns and rows of colorful threads for a bag or clothing project. Browse small indoor shops across several floors.
yongle-fabric.sourceTitle: Yongle Fabric Market | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor market with several floors; check the aisles and lifts on site.

yongle-fabric.imageAlt: Yongle Fabric Market — location photo: Sewing threads in many colors and materials
yongle-fabric.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

xiahai-temple.title: Watch worship and temple details at Xiahai Temple
xiahai-temple.description: Watch people offer incense and pray in front of the temple, then look at its decorations. Spend a short time observing local life, keeping clear of worshippers and following the flow of the crowd.
xiahai-temple.sourceTitle: Taipei Xiahai City God Temple | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Watch for crowds and thresholds in the temple forecourt; respect worshippers' routes.

xiahai-temple.imageAlt: Offering table, forecourt and worshipper at Xiahai City God Temple
xiahai-temple.imageCredit: 劉佳雯 / Taipei Department of Information and Tourism

raohe-shizu-pepper-bun.title: Try Shizu pepper buns at Raohe
raohe-shizu-pepper-bun.description: A crisp crust surrounds pork and scallions with a peppery kick. Enjoy a freshly baked bun if you are happy to stand and queue.
raohe-shizu-pepper-bun.sourceTitle: Taipei City Market Administration Office | Shizu Pepper Buns

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Mostly standing, queuing and walking; contains pork, sesame and a flour crust. Confirm ingredients and spice level with the shop.
facts.seasonalNote: The official introduction confirms the dish and photo; December 2026 opening, availability and prices are unconfirmed.

raohe-shizu-pepper-bun.imageAlt: A cut-open Shizu pepper bun showing pork, scallions and a sesame crust
raohe-shizu-pepper-bun.imageCredit: Taipei City Market Administration Office; original article photo credit: Tinn 庭庭最食尚

raohe-chen-dong-rib-soup.title: Have Chen Dong's herbal pork-rib soup
raohe-chen-dong-rib-soup.description: Sit down for pork-rib soup with herbal aromas and a lightly sweet broth. Take your time with the soup and meat rather than tour the whole market.
raohe-chen-dong-rib-soup.sourceTitle: Taipei City Market Administration Office | Chen Dong Herbal Pork-Rib Soup

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Seats and queues depend on conditions on site; contains pork and herbs. Confirm dietary requirements and ingredients with the vendor.
facts.seasonalNote: The official introduction confirms the dish and photo; December 2026 opening, availability and prices are unconfirmed.

raohe-chen-dong-rib-soup.imageAlt: Chen Dong herbal pork-rib soup with ribs, broth, red dates and goji berries
raohe-chen-dong-rib-soup.imageCredit: Taipei City Market Administration Office; original article photo credit: Tinn 庭庭最食尚

ningxia-snack.title: Try Liu Yu Zi's taro cakes at Ningxia
ningxia-snack.description: Fried taro surrounds egg yolk and pork floss for a warm savory-sweet snack. Make this one stop without exploring the entire market.
ningxia-snack.sourceTitle: Taipei City Market Administration Office | Liu Yu Zi Taro Cakes

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Mostly standing and queuing; the egg-yolk taro cake contains egg and pork floss. Confirm dietary requirements and allergens with the vendor.
facts.seasonalNote: The official introduction confirms the dish and photo; December 2026 opening, availability and prices are unconfirmed.

ningxia-snack.imageAlt: A cut-open Liu Yu Zi taro cake showing fried taro, egg yolk and pork floss
ningxia-snack.imageCredit: Taipei City Market Administration Office, official Liu Yu Zi introduction

east-ippudo-tonkotsu.title: Try Ippudo pork-broth ramen in the East District
east-ippudo-tonkotsu.description: Choose a bowl of thin noodles, sliced roast pork and rich pork-bone broth. The Fuxing SOGO branch is an option, but you may need to wait for a seat.
east-ippudo-tonkotsu.sourceTitle: Ippudo Taiwan | Official Menu and Fuxing SOGO Candidate Branch

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Confirm queues, seating, stairs and dietary requirements after choosing a shop.
facts.seasonalNote: The photo is the current official general menu cover and contains no prices. The official branch list confirms the Fuxing SOGO location; December 2026 menus, prices and opening still need checking.

east-ippudo-tonkotsu.imageAlt: Ippudo official general menu cover: two bowls of tonkotsu ramen with thin noodles, chashu, scallions and wood-ear mushrooms
east-ippudo-tonkotsu.imageCredit: Ippudo Taiwan official website / original general menu cover

yongkang-tea.title: Spend an hour or more over drinks on Yongkang Street
yongkang-tea.description: Find a tea shop or cafe around Yongkang Street, order a drink and sit with your companions for about 60–90 minutes. Leave other sights out of this time slot: browse fewer shops and spend longer talking and resting together.
yongkang-tea.sourceTitle: Yongkang Street | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Confirm seating, minimum spend and entrance access after choosing a shop.

101-observatory.title: See Taipei through the observatory windows
101-observatory.description: Take the lift up and look for streets, mountains and distant landmarks through large windows. Enjoy the height if tickets and possible mist do not put you off.

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor lifts and walking; tickets, entry routes and services follow official announcements.
facts.seasonalNote: Cloud or mist may limit the view. Unconfirmed New Year's Eve fireworks and outdoor high-altitude activities are not included.

101-observatory.imageAlt: Taipei 101 official 89th-floor observatory scene: visitors beside large windows looking over the city
101-observatory.imageCredit: Taipei 101 official website / Experience Old and New Taipei

101-shopping.title: Shop and dine at Taipei 101's mall
101-shopping.description: Browse indoor window displays and favorite shops, then find a restaurant. Focus on shopping and dining without making the observatory part of this stop.
101-shopping.sourceTitle: Taipei 101 | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Movement between floors; dining queues are possible at busy times.

101-shopping.imageAlt: Bright, tall mall passage and fashion displays at Taipei 101

fourfour-village.title: Explore the small old houses at Four Four South Village
fourfour-village.description: Walk slowly among low houses, green doors and windows, and shady trees to see what remains of the old homes. Enjoy the feel of everyday life in older buildings and stop outdoors to photograph details.
fourfour-village.sourceTitle: Xinyi Public Assembly Hall and Four Four South Village Cultural Park | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking outdoors and in old buildings; check thresholds, surfaces and open areas on site.
facts.seasonalNote: The photo shows the preserved houses, not an indoor display; no particular activity is guaranteed.

fourfour-village.imageAlt: Preserved low houses, green doors and windows, and shade trees at Four Four South Village
fourfour-village.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

npm-objects.title: Look closely at a few Palace Museum treasures
npm-objects.description: Choose ceramics, jade, paintings or calligraphy and study patterns, materials and details. Take your time indoors rather than cover every gallery.
npm-objects.sourceTitle: National Palace Museum Northern Branch | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor gallery walking; plan breaks and check official information on services and routes.
facts.seasonalNote: Objects rotate; a particular famous work is not guaranteed to be on display during your trip.

npm-objects.imageAlt: Jade disc and bird-shaped jade in the museum’s jade exhibition image

npm-garden.title: Explore the Palace Museum's buildings and gardens
npm-garden.description: Look at the main building's eaves, symmetry and outdoor gardens, with stops for photos. Prefer walking around the grounds to examining artifacts one by one.
npm-garden.sourceTitle: National Palace Museum Northern Branch | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking with slopes or stairs; open routes follow official announcements.
facts.seasonalNote: Check garden opening days, entry rules and weather before leaving.

npm-garden.imageAlt: National Palace Museum — location photo: The impressive main building of the National Palace Museum
npm-garden.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

ntm-architecture.title: See tall columns and the dome at Taiwan Museum
ntm-architecture.description: Look closely at the row of tall entrance columns and the dome above, then go inside to see the light in the hall. Spend this visit on the old building rather than trying to see every exhibit.
ntm-architecture.sourceTitle: National Taiwan Museum | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Movement through galleries and a historic building; check official access and lift information.

ntm-architecture.imageAlt: National Taiwan Museum exterior: entrance columns and dome
ntm-architecture.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data; photo: 許宜容

ntm-nature.title: See preserved animals and plants at Taiwan Museum
ntm-nature.description: Look at preserved animals and plants in display cases, known as specimens, or objects about life and history in Taiwan. Take time indoors to observe and read; the animals are not alive.
ntm-nature.sourceTitle: National Taiwan Museum | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor walking and reading; you can shorten the visit to suit yourself.
facts.seasonalNote: Galleries and special exhibitions may change; check announcements for your travel dates.

ntm-nature.imageAlt: Specimen case and suspended fish in the Exploring Taiwan gallery
ntm-nature.imageCredit: Ministry of Culture / National Taiwan Museum (2021 exhibition material)

railway-museum.title: Explore railway stories in historic buildings
railway-museum.description: See station models, tracks and railway displays inside the former railway administration building. Compare the miniature city with the real one and spend time reading its history.
railway-museum.sourceTitle: National Taiwan Museum | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor and outdoor movement in a historic complex; check thresholds and routes between floors with the museum.
facts.seasonalNote: The photograph records visitors viewing a model at the 2020 opening. Recheck model displays and running sessions for December.

railway-museum.imageAlt: Opening-day visitors viewing the railway and station scale model
railway-museum.imageCredit: National Taiwan Museum / Ministry of Culture (2020 opening material)

tfam-building.title: Explore white blocks and sculptures at Taipei Fine Arts Museum
tfam-building.description: Look at the building’s intersecting white block shapes and find angles to photograph outdoor sculptures around the plaza. Spend this time on the building and sculptures without necessarily visiting every gallery floor.
tfam-building.sourceTitle: Taipei Fine Arts Museum | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking in the plaza and museum; open areas follow museum announcements.

tfam-building.imageAlt: Taipei Fine Arts Museum — location photo: Taipei Fine Arts Museum (photo: 許宜容)
tfam-building.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data; photo: 許宜容

science-museum.title: Try hands-on science displays
science-museum.description: Try science exhibits and watch how pendulum balls move: predict the result, then read the explanation. Compare phenomena hands-on and spend time at each exhibit.
science-museum.sourceTitle: National Taiwan Science Education Center | Floor guide and Exploring Physics

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor movement between floors; individual facilities have operating or use restrictions.
facts.seasonalNote: A specific interactive display is not guaranteed to be available; sessions follow official announcements.

science-museum.imageAlt: Adult and child watching the pendulum experiment exhibit

miniatures.title: Look closely at miniature worlds
miniatures.description: Study tiny rooms, furniture and lines of soldiers for small details. Enjoy static models and slow viewing rather than constant walking.
miniatures.sourceTitle: Miniatures Museum of Taiwan | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor walking and close viewing; lighting and display height may affect the view.

miniatures.imageAlt: Miniatures Museum of Taiwan — location photo: Miniature soldier model at the Miniatures Museum (photo: 高讚賢)
miniatures.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data; photo: 高讚賢

huashan-buildings.title: Explore Huashan's plant-covered factory buildings
huashan-buildings.description: Follow the old brewery walls for plants, windows and building forms, with photo stops. Enjoy an outdoor architectural walk without choosing a ticketed exhibition.
huashan-buildings.sourceTitle: Huashan 1914 Creative Park | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking on outdoor surfaces and through old factory buildings; open areas depend on that day's activities.

huashan-buildings.imageAlt: Huashan old factory buildings with plant-covered exterior walls
huashan-buildings.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

songshan-design.title: Browse bags and craft goods at Songshan Cultural Park
songshan-design.description: Look at bags, craft goods and design products in shops inside the former tobacco factory. Compare materials and styles before deciding whether to buy, leaving time to browse slowly.
songshan-design.sourceTitle: Songshan Cultural and Creative Park | Design shops

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor and outdoor walking in the park; check event areas and thresholds on site.
facts.seasonalNote: The website currently lists the last Tuesday of each month as a closing day (December 29 during this trip). Recheck individual shops, stock and changes.

songshan-design.imageAlt: Product tables and shelves inside the factory’s design shops

zhongshan-books.title: Choose a book at Zhongshan's underground book street
zhongshan-books.description: Find a book among the rows of shelves and browse its title and contents. Enjoy a quiet indoor browse, then share why you chose it.
zhongshan-books.sourceTitle: Zhongshan Underground Book Street / Eslite R79 | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking through an underground passage; follow station signs and shop routes.

zhongshan-books.imageAlt: Zhongshan Underground Book Street / Eslite R79 — location photo: Main storefront of Eslite R79
zhongshan-books.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

red-house-roof.title: Look up at the octagonal wooden roof at Ximen Red House
red-house-roof.description: Look up at the wooden roof, beams and eight-sided space to see the old building’s details. Spend time on the architecture without necessarily browsing design goods; access to the second-floor theater needs confirmation.
red-house-roof.sourceTitle: The Red House | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor and outdoor walking at a historic building; floors and open areas follow venue announcements.
facts.seasonalNote: The roof photo shows the second-floor theater; access to that space depends on opening and performance arrangements that day.

red-house-roof.imageAlt: Timber beams and octagonal roof structure of the Red House second-floor theater
red-house-roof.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data; photo provided by The Red House

daan-pond.title: Watch pond plants and wait for birds at Daan Park
daan-pond.description: Stop beside the pond to look at plants growing in the water and their reflections, and wait to see whether birds appear. Enjoy quiet observation, even if no birds show up that day.
daan-pond.sourceTitle: Daan Forest Park | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking by the pond; keep your distance and do not feed wildlife.
facts.seasonalNote: Bird activity is not guaranteed; the photo only shows the location.

daan-pond.imageAlt: Daan Forest Park — location photo: Aquatic plants in the ecological pond
daan-pond.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

daan-rest.title: Walk 15 minutes, then sit and chat in Daan Park
daan-rest.description: Walk in Daan Park for about 15 minutes, then find a seat and chat for about 30–45 minutes. Walk less, rest more and leave other sights out of this time slot; seats depend on what is available when you arrive.
daan-rest.sourceTitle: Daan Forest Park | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking; you can shorten the route. Seating depends on availability.

botanical-garden.title: Look at hanging tree roots and leaves at Taipei Botanical Garden
botanical-garden.description: Walk into the shade to look at roots hanging from large trees, compare leaf shapes and read plant names. Take time to notice details rather than visiting for a particular flowering season.
botanical-garden.sourceTitle: Taipei Botanical Garden | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Outdoor garden paths may be slippery after rain; follow garden rules.
facts.seasonalNote: Summer lotus flowers or any particular blooms are not guaranteed in December.

botanical-garden.imageAlt: Taipei Botanical Garden — location photo: A large tree covered in aerial roots
botanical-garden.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

xiangshan.title: Climb Elephant Mountain stairs (construction)
xiangshan.description: Climb continuous stairs for another view of Taipei 101 and the city. Some sections are under construction; check the available detour before going.

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Repeated stairs and slopes rather than a level stroll; consider slippery conditions after rain.
facts.seasonalNote: The official notice schedules works on some sections from 2026-07-20 to 2027-04-13; work areas are closed. Recheck available routes and detours before the December visit.

xiangshan.imageAlt: Continuous stone stairs and a walker under trees on Elephant Mountain

beitou-library.title: Admire Beitou Library's wooden green building
beitou-library.description: Look at wooden screens, deep balconies and surrounding trees, then browse quietly. Enjoy architecture and reading while respecting quiet and photography rules.
beitou-library.sourceTitle: Taipei Public Library / Beitou Branch | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor and outdoor movement across several floors; keep quiet and follow library photography rules.

beitou-library.imageAlt: Taipei Public Library / Beitou Branch — location photo: The timber library building has a nostalgic feel
beitou-library.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

thermal-valley.title: Watch steam from Thermal Valley's paths
thermal-valley.description: Observe steam and trees from behind the barriers and experience the hot spring smell. Explore the geology, with level changes and no entry to the water.
thermal-valley.sourceTitle: Thermal Valley / Hell Valley / Ghost Lake | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Slopes and very hot water; obey barriers and warning signs. Do not enter the water.
facts.seasonalNote: Steam effects depend on the weather; opening and maintenance follow official announcements.

thermal-valley.imageAlt: Thermal Valley / Hell Valley / Ghost Lake — location photo: Trees around the lake create a natural setting (source: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism)
thermal-valley.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

maokong-path.title: Explore rural scenery on Maokong's Zhangshu Trail
maokong-path.description: Walk past a pond, boardwalks and surrounding fields, pausing for the scenery. Enjoy a mountain stroll with changes in elevation and possible slippery surfaces.

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: An outdoor trail with some changes in elevation; it may be slippery after rain. Adjust the distance to suit yourself.
facts.seasonalNote: No December flower fields are promised; check mountain weather and road conditions before leaving.

maokong-path.imageAlt: Rural scenery on Zhangshu Trail: a pond, wooden boardwalk and fields
maokong-path.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

dahu-lake.title: Find bridges and reflections at Dahu Park
dahu-lake.description: Follow the lakeside for Jiuqu Bridge and reflections, framing bridge, mountains and water. Choose a slow lake walk without climbing the arched bridge.
dahu-lake.sourceTitle: Dahu Park | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Lakeside walking; the arched bridge has stairs, and you can choose not to climb it.

dahu-lake.imageAlt: Dahu Park — location photo: Jiuqu Bridge, named for its nine curves and thirteen bends
dahu-lake.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

guandu-temple.title: See dragon columns and colorful roofs at Guandu Temple
guandu-temple.description: Stop to look at dragons on the columns, stone carvings and colorful roofs, then leave time for the river view. Enjoy close-up temple details and choose a route suited to your stamina around stairs and level changes.
guandu-temple.sourceTitle: Taipei Guandu Temple Foundation | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: The temple grounds have level changes and stairs; choose routes to suit your stamina and respect worshippers.

guandu-temple.imageAlt: Carved dragon columns, stone rails and colorful roof ridges at Guandu Temple, with visitors in front
guandu-temple.imageCredit: Taipei Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data

riverside-cycle.title: Cycle a short stretch of the Keelung River
riverside-cycle.description: Ride slowly along a riverside route past bridges, grass and open sky. Choose this active stop if you cycle safely; agree on distance and a turning point together.
riverside-cycle.sourceTitle: Keelung River Riverside Cycle Path | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: You need to be able to cycle safely; confirm rentals, bike types, helmets and route conditions separately.
facts.seasonalNote: Reschedule for rain, strong wind or route closures. Do not assume cycling suits everyone.

riverside-cycle.imageAlt: The paved Keelung River riverside cycle route and nearby bridge
riverside-cycle.imageCredit: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data; photo: 許宜容

tfam-sakamoto.title: Step into light and sound at Taipei Fine Arts Museum
tfam-sakamoto.description: Enter Ryuichi Sakamoto’s exhibition and watch light and images while listening to sound in dim rooms. Slow down to experience the whole space, allowing for reservations and darker galleries.
tfam-sakamoto.sourceTitle: Taipei Fine Arts Museum | Ryuichi Sakamoto: seeing sound, hearing time (announced 2026-10-31 to 2027-03-14)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Walking and pausing in dim galleries; responses to sound and light vary. Check visiting rules.
facts.seasonalNote: The official announced run is 2026-10-31 to 2027-03-14. Recheck December reservations, tickets and changes. The photo shows the same work at the Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo in 2024, not the Taipei installation.

tfam-sakamoto.imageAlt: Light installation by Ryuichi Sakamoto and Daito Manabe, exhibited in Tokyo in 2024
tfam-sakamoto.imageCredit: Ryuichi Sakamoto + Daito Manabe; photo: 浅野豪; ©2024 KAB Inc. / TFAM

moca-after-museum.title: See art made with everyday objects at MOCA Taipei
moca-after-museum.description: In After the Museum, see how artists use images, everyday objects and whole rooms to present their work. Take time to look and discuss what the works mean, beyond admiring beautiful paintings.
moca-after-museum.sourceTitle: MoCA Taipei | After the Museum (2026-09-19 to 12-31)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Indoor gallery movement; check current information on sound, lighting effects and access routes.
facts.seasonalNote: The official announced run is 2026-09-19 to 2026-12-31. The trip’s last day is the announced closing date; recheck opening, tickets and changes.

moca-after-museum.imageAlt: Blue gallery and objects in Rest Room, part of After the Museum
moca-after-museum.imageCredit: MoCA Taipei | Official photograph of Rest Room

beitou-kagaya-private-bath.title: Unwind in a private bath at Kagaya
beitou-kagaya-private-bath.description: Choose a private pool for a hot soak and a rest. Rooms accommodate a few people, so relax in small groups rather than fitting the whole party into one room.
beitou-kagaya-private-bath.sourceTitle: Beitou Kagaya | Fifth-floor private hot-spring rooms

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: Consider individual physical condition when entering the pool and choosing water temperature. Confirm handrails and access with the operator.
facts.seasonalNote: The website currently lists 90-minute sessions for two people, with some room types allowing up to four for additional fees. No booking has been made; confirm December room types, facilities, opening and prices.

beitou-kagaya-private-bath.imageAlt: Wooden pool, private room and window light in Kagaya’s Ting Quan series

beitou-hotel-history.title: Explore old hotel objects at the hot-spring museum
beitou-hotel-history.description: Look at a hotel counter, wooden walls and old objects, and imagine past bathing and overnight stays in Beitou. This is an indoor history visit, without entering a bath.
beitou-hotel-history.sourceTitle: Beitou Hot Spring Museum | Tourism Administration Open Tourism Multimedia Data (Taipei City source)

facts.cost: Confirm on site or with official announcements
facts.mobility: A historic building with floors, thresholds and visiting rules; check the museum's routes first.
facts.seasonalNote: The official photo shows a historical-object display. Recheck the gallery layout for December; a museum visit does not include bathing.

beitou-hotel-history.imageAlt: Old hot-spring hotel counter, clock and objects displayed at the Beitou museum
beitou-hotel-history.imageCredit: Taipei Department of Information and Tourism / Tourism Administration open data
